description: Registry of all data sources for the US County-Level Observatory

sources.name: IPUMS NHGIS
sources.description: Pre-harmonized demographic, social, economic, housing data from US Census
sources.notes: Requires manual extract definition; 389 time series tables + 1,300+ ACS tables

sources.name: CDC WONDER Mortality Database
sources.description: Mortality data by cause of death, demographics, and geography

temporal_coverage.note: Public county-level data ends 2016; 2017+ requires restricted access or web scraping

implementation_challenges.api_limitation: CDC WONDER API does not support county-level queries (national only)
implementation_challenges.cmf_files: Compressed Mortality Files public access ends at 2016
implementation_challenges.nber_limitation: NBER repository removed county codes from 2005+ files
implementation_challenges.web_scraping: CDC WONDER web interface supports county-level but requires scraping (~17 hours with rate limits)
implementation_challenges.restricted_data: Current county-level data requires NCHS application (4-6 weeks approval)

sources.notes: DEPRIORITIZED: County-level data not easily accessible for recent years. See docs/CDC_WONDER_IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES.md for full analysis
sources.blocked_reason: Public county-level data unavailable for recent years (2017+)
resolution_options: Apply for NCHS restricted data access (requires institutional support)
Wait for CDC CMF update (may release 2017-2020 eventually)
Implement CDC WONDER web scraping (high complexity, 3-4 days development)
Use national-level data only (not suitable for county observatory)

sources.name: USGS National Water Information System
sources.description: Water quality and quantity data from monitoring stations
sources.notes: Station-level data requires spatial aggregation to counties
